goal.vi: Gọi đồ uống lịch sự, chọn cỡ và trả tiền.
goal.en: Order a drink politely, choose a size and pay.

lines: Hi there! What can I get for you?
Hi! Can I get a latte, please?
Sure. What size would you like?
A medium, please. Could I have it without sugar?
No problem. For here or to go?
To go, please. Can I pay by card?

phrases.say: Can I get a latte, please?

mean.vi: Gọi đồ một cách lịch sự

why.vi: "I want…" nghe như ra lệnh; "Can I get…, please?" lịch sự và rất phổ biến.
why.en: "I want…" can sound rude; "Can I get…, please?" is polite and very common.

mean.vi: Nói điều bạn muốn một cách nhẹ nhàng
mean.en: Say what you want in a soft way

why.vi: "Give me" nghe như mệnh lệnh; "I'd like…" lịch sự hơn nhiều.
why.en: "Give me" sounds like an order; "I'd like…" is much more polite.

mean.vi: Nói bạn muốn mang đồ đi
mean.en: Say you want to take your drink with you

why.vi: "Take away it" sai ngữ pháp. Nói "To go, please" (Mỹ) hoặc "Takeaway, please" (Anh).
why.en: "Take away it" is not correct. Say "To go, please" (US) or "Takeaway, please" (UK).

mean.vi: Hỏi có trả bằng thẻ được không
mean.en: Ask if you can pay with a card

why.vi: Nói "by card" hoặc "with a card"; "with card" thiếu "a" nghe sai.
why.en: Say "by card" or "with a card"; "with card" without "a" sounds wrong.

mean.vi: Câu nói khi đưa tiền hoặc đồ cho ai
mean.en: What you say when you give money or something to someone

why.vi: "Here you go" thân thiện; "Take it" nghe lạnh lùng.
why.en: "Here you go" sounds friendly; "Take it" sounds cold.

phrases.say: Could I have it without sugar?
phrases.not: No sugar for me, I don't want.

mean.vi: Đổi món theo ý mình một cách lịch sự

why.vi: Dùng "Could I have it without…?" để bỏ bớt thứ gì đó.
why.en: Use "Could I have it without…?" to leave something out.

phrases.say: Sorry, I think this isn't what I ordered.

mean.vi: Báo nhầm món mà không gay gắt
mean.en: Say there is a mistake without sounding angry

why.vi: Mở đầu bằng "Sorry, I think…" giúp sửa lỗi nhẹ nhàng.
why.en: Starting with "Sorry, I think…" fixes the problem gently.

ai.name: Alex
ai.role: a barista in a busy café
ai.persona: cheerful and quick, but patient with learners
ai.goal: take the learner's order and payment

roleplay.you: Order a drink, choose a size, say for here or to go, and pay.

turns.a: Hi there! What can I get for you?
turns.h: Hi! Can I get a latte, please?

turns.a: That's four fifty. How would you like to pay?

roleplay.end: Here's your receipt. Have a nice day!
